codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero on Steam or PS5: Which Edition to Buy
directions.question: Buy Phantom Blade Zero Standard on Steam if your Windows PC meets the requirements below, or buy Standard on PlayStation Store if you will play on PS5. Standard is the recommended starting purchase on either platform. Choose Digital Deluxe only if you want its two exclusive outfits, digital art book and soundtrack.

directions.title: Is Phantom Blade Zero a Soulslike? The Differences That Matter
directions.question: Phantom Blade Zero is a wuxia action RPG. “Soulslike” describes some recognizable features—dangerous bosses, defensive timing and connected environments—but it is an incomplete guide to how the game plays. Difficulty options, fast weapon switching and forgiving boss-phase restarts change the experience substantially.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Difficulty: Pick the Right Challenge
directions.question: Start with Pathbreaker if you want to learn the full combat rhythm without immediately choosing the harshest challenge. Choose Wayfarer if enjoying the story and martial-arts spectacle matters more than repeated boss practice. Choose Hellwalker if you actively want more demanding opponents.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Combat Guide: Parry, Dodge and Keep Pressure
directions.question: Learn three habits first: respond to blue attacks with a timed parry, evade red attacks, and switch weapons before poor Sha-Chi management leaves you helpless. Then use short, reliable combinations during openings. Phantom Blade Zero rewards aggressive fighting, but sustainable aggression depends on recognizing when an enemy is still attacking.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Weapons: What to Equip and Upgrade First
directions.question: Use Jagged Steel as your early damage weapon, add Outlaw Warblade for healing once you reach Jing Ye, and equip Reflex Device while learning parries and perfect dodges. For Phantom Edges, start with Dread Axe for guard pressure and Hunter’s Chain Sickle for reach.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Bosses: Beat Peng Meng and Gold Mask
directions.question: Against Peng Meng, parry blue axe attacks, dodge the red grab and wait for the whole combination to end before punishing. Against the first Gold-Masked One, create openings with timed defense and Sha-Chi breaks instead of forcing repeated free swings.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Walkthrough: Forest, Keys and Lake Route
directions.question: Crimson Forest is both a campaign region and a place you revisit as side tales develop. Before leaving its first major story phase, check Yu’er’s healer objectives and the Baishan tale; later progress changes what you can reach and which encounters appear.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Map: Find the Right Region and Route
directions.question: For a regional interactive map, start with MapGenie’s Phantom Blade Zero directory and choose the named region you are exploring. Its Crimson Forest map includes separate categories for bells, keys, quest items, weapons and characters, making it useful when you know what kind of object you need.

directions.title: Phantom Blade Zero Platinum: Protect Missables Before Cleanup
directions.question: Phantom Blade Zero’s platinum can be earned on any difficulty in one carefully planned playthrough. The trophy list has 36 trophies, but combat difficulty is not the main planning risk: several side tales can fail as the story advances. Keep separate manual saves, finish time-sensitive conversations promptly and prepare the true-ending route before committing to the finale.

descriptionItems.label: The Wulin world
descriptionItems.text: Soul is a framed assassin in S-GAME’s wuxia action RPG. His search for the truth leads through a dark martial-arts world, where rival factions and old loyalties shape the conflict.

descriptionItems.label: Blades, timing and exploration
descriptionItems.text: Explore connected regions, follow side tales and face demanding duels. Learn attack warnings, manage Sha-Chi, switch weapons and build a loadout around the openings you can use reliably.
